title: Pee-wee Russell and Bix living together in New York
summary: Hazel recalls visiting Bix and Pee-wee at their hotel, Bix's piano playing, and Pee-wee's stint in New Orleans with Louis Prima.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Yeah, Pee-wee, Russell and Bix were living together. Must have been quite a household. At the 44th Street Hotel in New York, and they had a little yacht, you used to call them yacht pianos in those days. Really, two and a half octave piano. So they'd get, I used to go there around 11 o'clock. I lived on 53rd and Broadway. And I used to go there around 11, 12 o'clock, and they'd get up about that time, you know. And they'd have to sit the gin sitting on the bed table, you know, and they'd get up, and they'd go in the bathroom. And Bix would try, they'd take a swallowing, you know. And most of the time, the first one wouldn't stay down, and Pee-wee tried, and he couldn't stay, get it to stay down. Well, they'd keep trying until they got one to stay down. The minute they got one to stay down, they'd throw the whole bottle down, you know. That must have been bad gin. Yeah, and then Bix would sit down there, but oh, he'd play beautiful piano. He'd made a lot of things, you know, like that.

In a Mist, and all those kind of things. And he'd sit down and play those. And Pee-wee, Pee-wee has played some wonderful things. Pee-wee, but at one time, he'd play erratic, and another time, he'd play real pretty, and another time, he'd do what Muggsy used to call squawk. Muggsy made a novel one time. And then one tune on there, he'd call it Pee-wee Squawks again. But Pee-wee was, well, he was here for quite a while with Lurie Primer, you know. They went ahead to that place over on Bourbon Street. That's a place called the Shim Shim. Oh, that's back in the early 30s, Doug. And Pee-wee was around here for about six months. And that's before Lurie got big, you see, before he got real big.
